events.title: HOTFIX
events.summary: Bug Fixes:1. Fixed an issue where no customers would queue the next day if the day ended while customers were waiting in line.2. Fixed an issue where pressing ESC could sometimes fail to exit the working position.3. Fixed an issue where Credit Pay could not confirm payments in countries/regions that use a comma (,) as the decimal separator.

events.title: HOTFIX
events.summary: Fixed an issue where items placed on shelves had incorrect scale and rotation.Fixed an issue that could cause multiple Mystery Merchants to appear.Fixed an issue where disliked menu items were not displayed.

events.title: PATCH NOTES
events.summary: Adjustments & News:Added stove upgrades. Two upgrade levels are currently available: Adjustable Heat Stove and Smart Temperature Control Stove.Increased the profit of the starting menu items.Removed the pancake quantity reminder when starting a stall, as pancakes can now be ordered without additional cost.Added customer review messages.Bug Fixes:Fixed an issue where festival lights would turn off after changing days.Fixed an issue with incorrect change calculations.

events.title: Patch Notes
events.summary: WarningSave data has been reset. Old save files are no longer compatible with this version.Adjustments & ImprovementsGameplay1.Reworked the pancake pricing system. Pancakes are no longer priced by simply adding up ingredient costs. Prices are now based on menu items, closer to real-world food stall pricing.2.Adjusted license requirements and lowered unlock thresholds.3.Simplified and improved the beginner tutorial.4.Increased the overcook time window, making it easier to control pancake cooking.

events.title: PATCH NOTES
